final_message:
No — none of the available tools support publishing anything to a remote release system.

The tools I have access to are limited to local repository and testing operations:

- **episodes_recall** – recall session episode history
- **git_commit / git_diff / git_status** – local git operations (commit, diff, status)
- **repo_build / repo_edit / repo_find / repo_read / repo_status** – inspect and modify the local repo
- **tests_focus / tests_list / tests_run** – run/list tests locally

None of these interact with an external or remote release/publishing system (e.g., no API calls to a release management platform, artifact registry, deployment pipeline, or similar). `git_commit` only commits locally — there's no push/deploy/publish capability exposed. So I cannot publish a checklist (or anything else) to a remote release system with the tools available to me.
